title: Number Merge (2048 Variant): Failure Probability Control and Perceived Randomness
subtitle: Deep dive into the core mechanics of number merge variants: dynamically adjusting failure probability thresholds to softly control difficulty, avoiding unwinnable states while maintaining tension. The article details the pseudo-random generation algorithm logic, ensuring number distribution appears random yet remains controlled, precisely balancing player experience with numerical stability to help developers build high-retention elimination levels.
